## Change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. For a placeholder or documentation change, state its scope.

## Validation

List the checks actually performed and the environment used. Include an actual package preview for visual changes, and identify any checks still pending.

## Packaging and licensing

For component changes, describe installation and removal or rollback. Identify added or changed third-party sources, licenses and attribution. Write “Not applicable” when this change contains none.
